items.title: feat(models): expose canonical model family in models.list and the re…
items.summary: feat(models): expose canonical model family in models.list and the requester catalog (#181685) Add an optional `family` to model catalog rows: the developer lineage a provider or catalog declares, such as `anthropic` for every route serving a Claude model. Bundled single-developer catalogs declare it per provider and the GitHub Copilot catalog per row. Copilot discovery maps its model `vendor`, and ClawRouter routed rows take the family of the exact bundled upstream row. Unknown models carry no family; nothing is inferred from model ids or names. The family follows catalog route rules: a configured model that moves to another API or endpoint drops it, a hosted overlay keeps the bundled row's family, and a malformed persisted value drops only that fact. `models.list` rows, the protocol schema and the plugin requester catalog expose it, advertised to plugins as `requester-model-family-v1`.

items.title: 日本遊戲大廠卡普空會員資料外洩逾1,177萬筆，近200個帳號的密碼遭改
items.summary: 日本遊戲大廠卡普空（Capcom）證實，旗下會員帳號服務CAPCOM ID遭第三方入侵，導致全球超過1,177萬筆會員資料外洩，其中有196個帳號的登入密碼遭擅自變更。卡普空表示，未發現會員自行設定的密碼外洩，信用卡資料也不在此次外洩範圍。 CAPCOM ID是卡普空旗下網路服務及部分線上遊戲使用的共用帳號。外洩資料包括會員電子郵件地址、帳號建立時間、最後登入時間、登入次數，以及最後登入時使用的IP位址，而有43筆還包含出生年月日、性別、國家或地區及暱稱。
